Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart’s father as John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute (the grandfather), instead of John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart (Viscount Mount Stuart), as indicated in the search snippets. This conflation of father and grandfather redirected all subsequent searches to the wrong person’s death date (1814) rather than the correct father who died in 1794, causing the downstream error.
